name: alicankorkmaz-marketplace
description: Skills for coding agents: learning (fast-learning and road-to-mastery) and presenting (talk-studio, a stateful workspace for researching and planning a talk).

plugins.name: learning
plugins.description: Two learning skills: fast-learning (do one concrete thing by a deadline: placement test, 20% syllabus, retrieval checks, spaced-retrieval queue, graded explain-backs) and road-to-mastery (mentorship to expertise: mission, diagnosis, adaptive challenges with multi-approach expert feedback, elite mental models, spaced recall).

plugins.name: presenting
plugins.description: talk-studio: prepare a talk across sessions. Graded research knowledge base you can question, decisions log, and a narrative flow document with per-section slides, conversation questions and bridges.
